title: EW Production Factory Model

stages.name: Draft
stages.description: Author initial ExplanationWrong text for each distractor. Choice-specific, concept-driven, trap-name-labeled.
stages.perItemTime: 15 minutes (3 distractors × 5 min each for MCQ; 30 min for case items with more complex distractors)
stages.qualityGate: Non-empty, not boilerplate, references specific concept tested

stages.name: Review
stages.description: Peer review for accuracy, choice-specificity, instructional value. Verify the explanation actually addresses WHY this choice is wrong.
stages.qualityGate: No template text, contains domain-specific reasoning, different from other distractor EWs

stages.name: Technical QA
stages.description: Automated scan: DL-008 check (empty EW[CC]), empty-slot check, boilerplate check, minimum-length check (>=50 chars).

stages.name: Certification Candidate
stages.description: Promote item to certification-ready. EW is now complete and QA-passed. Item is ready for full CAQS §1.6 certification review.

process.cycleTime: ~8.5 hours per batch (6.25 hrs drafting + 2 hrs review + 0.25 hrs QA)
process.throughputVsAdHoc: Factory model: 50 items/session. Ad-hoc (current): ~39 items/session per S308. 28% throughput improvement.

comparisonToCurrent.currentApproach: EW authoring embedded in certification waves. Authors produce EW as part of cert review. No dedicated factory pipeline.
comparisonToCurrent.advantage: Factory decouples EW authoring from certification — authors specialize, reviewers specialize, QA is automated.
comparisonToCurrent.disadvantage: Requires upfront process design investment (1 session to set up factory templates and QA scripts).

implementation.setup: 1 session to create: EW template library (common trap patterns), QA automation script, review checklist, batch tracking manifest
implementation.rollout: Pilot with 1 batch (25 items) to validate cycle time and quality. Then scale to full production.
implementation.recommendedFirstTarget: Case-bank Domain C items (298 items, near-zero EW). Highest learner impact — transforms case practice from zero feedback to full coaching.

sessionsSaved: 2-3 sessions across the EW program (from reduced rework and higher throughput)
